changes.profile_in_filing: Mrs. Lily Vadera, has over 34 years of experience in Central banking. She is a M.A in International Relations. She retired as an Executive Director from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in October 2020. As the Executive Director of the RBI, she was in-charge of the Department of Regulation (DoR) where she dealt with the regulatory framework for various entities in financial sector, covering all categories of banks and non-banking finance companies.
